reviews.title: Sleep Health
reviews.text: Good sleep health is just as important as healthy eating and exercise.  Without it our bodies would be unbalanced and out of sync.  This great app helps you track your sleep just like a calorie/micro nutrient tracker would for food and a pedometer would for steps. It gives you a clearer picture of how you slept when otherwise you would have no clue of your “sleep details”.  It really gives you great information.  It also gives you a visual indicator for all those non-sleep Doctors out there, like me.   I absolutely love that there is no subscription, just a one-time fee.  This tool has been super helpful, I am excited to wake and see all the details of how I slept the night before. But always remember, it’s more important to feel well rested than to read that you slept well.

reviews.title: My Healing Tracker ❤️‍🩹
reviews.text:
I’ve started thinking of AutoSleep as more than a sleep tracker. For me, it has become a healing tracker.

After going through a major health event, sleep means something completely different to me now. Every hour of good, restorative sleep feels like time I’m giving my body and brain to recover, repair, and become stronger.

Last night I slept 7 hours and 21 minutes, and seeing that number genuinely made me happy. I’m working toward getting a consistent 8 hours, but I’m learning to celebrate the progress instead of only focusing on what I haven’t reached yet.

When I open AutoSleep in the morning, I’m not just looking at sleep statistics. I’m looking at part of my recovery journey.

Sleep, for me, means healing. ❤️‍🩹 One night at a time.

reviews.title: Immediate Positive Impact
reviews.text: This app has really improved our lives. Having a daily, quantitative review of your sleep, and being able to correlate the results with how you feel, motivates you to change your habits. Many of my orthopedic issues (lower back, shoulder, neck) have improved significantly, simply because I’ve learned that sleep quality has a tremendous impact on bodily recovery. Similarly, recognition of “readiness” and how it predicts work performance and energy during the day, motivates you to change various sleep habits to improve readiness. This app has made real tangible improvements in my life and I recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: Great ideas, poorly implemented
reviews.text:
This app costs little compared to the others since it’s one fee and no subscriptions. But the UI makes it difficult to add sleep times if you forget to wear your watch (it takes 6 steps to get to where you add the time manually). It does not synch with the Apple Sleep but it detects the sleep by itself and it ignores any Apple Sleep changes. 
The sleep apnea feature is great! But the most important part is having accurate times for sleep start and sleep end. I had it for a week and then I erased it since it does not do what it needs to.
I’ll check in the future and if it’s subscription and it works, I’ll try it again.

reviews.title: Great App, Great Updates
reviews.text: I’ve been using AutoSleep off and on for years now and just came on the App Store to see if I could send the developer some more money for all of the wonderful service it has provided me. I’ve hit a period of serious insomnia again and am going to start back to using it every night so I can track my sleep and provide myself and my doctor some useful data to try and solve this current cycle. It is a great tool, and I recommend it as a relatively easy, but data-rich method for getting to the heart of your sleep patterns. It takes time up front to set up, and to learn to fine tune for your best style of understanding, which I believe is one of its greatest assets. But the investment is well worth it. And the cost is absolutely well worth the value of the quality of the product.
